mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, c.inviter_id, c.invitee_id, cs.first_goal_type, cs.target_amount, cs.target_period_months FROM couple c INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.id = c.invitation_code_id INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}

SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, m.birth_date,
agm.median_financial_asset AS age_group_asset_median,
ps.annual_income, ps.monthly_available_amount, ps.financial_asset_ratio, ps.financial_knowledge, ps.capital_preservation_attitude,
COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX( CASE psie.investment_experience WHEN 'LOW_RISK' THEN 1 WHEN 'MODERATE_LOW_RISK' THEN 2 WHEN 'MODERATE_RISK' THEN 3 WHEN 'MODERATE_HIGH_RISK' THEN 4 WHEN 'HIGH_RISK' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END ) FROM personal_survey_investment_experience psie WHERE psie.personal_survey_id = ps.id ), 0 ) AS investment_experience_score,
fs.financial_asset, fs.total_debt, fs.annual_debt_payment,
pia.pension_saving_balance, pia.irp_balance, pia.pension_annual_payment, pia.irp_annual_payment, pia.dc_annual_payment, pia.isa_annual_deposit, pia.tax_eligibility_status, pia.isa_eligibility_status
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN personal_survey ps ON ps.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN financial_summary fs ON fs.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN pension_isa_account pia ON pia.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN age_group_asset_median agm ON agm.age_min <= TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.birth_date, CURDATE()) AND ( agm.age_max IS NULL OR agm.age_max >= TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.birth_date, CURDATE()) ) AND agm.base_year = ( SELECT MAX(latest_agm.base_year) FROM age_group_asset_median latest_agm )
WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, couple_id, asset_stability_score, debt_repayment_score, financial_value_score, goal_feasibility_score, tax_strategy_score, tax_strategy_calculated, total_score, result_summary FROM compatibility_result WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compatibility_result ( couple_id, asset_stability_score, debt_repayment_score, financial_value_score, goal_feasibility_score, tax_strategy_score, tax_strategy_calculated, total_score ) VALUES ( #{coupleId}, #{result.assetStabilityScore}, #{result.debtRepaymentScore}, #{result.financialValueScore}, #{result.goalFeasibilityScore}, #{result.taxStrategyScore}, #{result.taxStrategyCalculated}, #{result.totalScore} )
